say:2:1110301002:1.text: Ah! Soren and Alsa of the Uru Clan! Yes, this is indeed a spider egg unique to the sand spider!
say:2:1110301002:1.source_cn: 哦！你们是乌尔氏族的索恩和阿尔萨！嗯，验证无误——这确...

say:3:1110301003:1.text: Everyone, let's congratulate the Uru Clan for passing their first trial! A round of applause for these two young warriors!
say:3:1110301003:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉的老朋友们，让我们恭喜乌尔氏族通过第一道试炼！给...

say:4:1110301004:1.text: Whoa! Soren, they're cheering for us!
say:4:1110301004:1.source_cn: 哇！索恩，大家在为我们鼓掌呢！

say:5:1110301005:1.text: Hello, everyone! The Uru Clan welcomes you if you visit! Tell them you know Alsa!
say:5:1110301005:1.source_cn: 大家好！欢迎大家来乌尔氏族做客，记得报我阿尔萨的名字哦！

say:7:1110301006:1.text: The Uru Clan is weak! Go home! You're not welcome at the Warsong Festival!
say:7:1110301006:1.source_cn: ——乌尔氏族的弱者，快滚回家吧！战歌节不欢迎你们！

say:9:1110301008:1.text: Don't you know how crazy your odds are? Because you returned from the trial, some people lost a fortune betting against you!
say:9:1110301008:1.source_cn: 呵！你们不知道自己赔率多离谱吗？光是能从赤沙蛛域回来，...

say:10:1110301009:1.text: Those who underestimate us will surely pay the price.
say:10:1110301009:1.source_cn: 小看我们的人，将我们视为弱者的人——我说过，迟早要让他...

choice_prompt:11:1110301009.text: Those who underestimate us will surely pay the price.
choice_prompt:11:1110301009.source_cn: 小看我们的人，将我们视为弱者的人——我说过，迟早要让他们付出代价。

say:12:1110301010:1.text: I am calm. One day, the entire desert will know the power of the Uru Clan.
say:12:1110301010:1.source_cn: 我没生气。总有一天，整片沙漠都会知道，乌尔氏族不可小觑……

say:14:1110301013:2.text: Stop right there! Tender words have no place here! Mikola and friends prefer the roars of victory and the cries of the defeated!
say:14:1110301013:2.source_cn: 打住打住！完全不想听这么温情款款的抚慰哦！曼卡拉和老朋...

say:15:1110301014:1.text: No matter how strong our enemy is, we will never cry out.
say:15:1110301014:1.source_cn: 我们不会惨叫的。即使敌人再强也一样。

say:16:1110301015:1.text: Is that so? Remember what you just said, young warriors. It's time to get ready for our second test, the <style="highlight">Trial of Souls</style>.
say:16:1110301015:1.source_cn: 是吗？记住你现在的话，年轻的勇士，迎接我们的第二道试炼...

say:17:1110301016:1.text: You may wonder what this trial is about, but that's a secret. Someone will come find you when the trial begins.
say:17:1110301016:1.source_cn: 不过，试炼内容暂时保密，耐心等待即可。试炼开始时，会有...

say:18:1110301017:1.text: So does that mean we can rest and wait back at the Uru Clan until the trial starts?
say:18:1110301017:1.source_cn: 这是不是说明，我们可以先回乌尔氏族休整，等待试炼开始？

say:19:1110301018:1.text: Great! Soren, it's time to go home!

say:21:1110301011:1.text: I'm not! Actually, I really want to go back and check on everyone at home.
say:21:1110301011:1.source_cn: 其实我没在难过啦！而且，我是真的很想快点滚回家里去看看呢！

say:22:1110301012:1.text: I'm not sure if Soren and I left enough food for everyone. I hope they're not hungry...
say:22:1110301012:1.source_cn: 唉，也不知道我和索恩出来这么久，给大家留的食物够不够，...

say:0:1110302001:0.text: I miss everyone! I wonder if they're thinking of me too.
say:0:1110302001:0.source_cn: 好想大家！好想知道大家有没有想我！

say:1:1110302002:0.text: I definitely think of you whenever my stomach rumbles.
say:1:1110302002:0.source_cn: 饿肚子的时候，可能会想到阿尔萨的。

say:2:1110302003:0.text: Huh? You make me sound like I'm some emergency food supply!
say:2:1110302003:0.source_cn: 哈？说得我像什么储备粮一样！

say:0:1110303001:0.text: Hey, everyone! We're back! Did you have enough to eat?
say:0:1110303001:0.source_cn: 孩子们！我们回来啦！最近生活得怎么样，还吃——

say:1:1110303002:0.text: Soren! Alsa! The Grimmaw Clan is here looking for you!
say:1:1110303002:0.source_cn: 索恩，阿尔萨……有、有人来找你们了！是黑嚎氏族的人！

say:1:1110305001:1.text: Soren, you've proven your strength. The Grimmaw Clan would like you to come back to us.
say:1:1110305001:1.source_cn: 索恩，现在你已经证明了自己的实力。黑嚎氏族愿意重新接纳你。

say:2:1110305002:2.text: That's right! Come back! After all, we share the same blood. Don't waste time with these weaklings.
say:2:1110305002:2.source_cn: 是啊，快回来吧！与你血脉同源的族人是我们，别跟这些弱者...

say:3:1110305003:1.text: When I was born, you saw me as a weakling. I was still in my swaddling clothes, and you threw me into the desert to die...
say:3:1110305003:1.source_cn: 出生后，把我打上“弱小”烙印的，剥去我的襁褓，将我遗弃...

say:4:1110305004:1.text: ...and now you're saying "we share the same blood".

say:5:1110305005:1.text: It's deathly cold in the desert after nightfall. When you left a defenseless infant there, did you hope for it to <style="stress">survive</style> or <style="stress">die</style>?
say:5:1110305005:1.source_cn: 沙漠的黑夜滴水成冰。你们把一个婴儿遗弃在那里，是想让他...

say:6:1110305006:1.text: Since the day Pops took me in, I have been Soren of the Uru Clan.
say:6:1110305006:1.source_cn: 从老爹收留我的那一刻起，我就只是乌尔氏族的索恩了。

say:7:1110305007:1.text: What are we, the Grimmaw Clan, to you then?
say:7:1110305007:1.source_cn: 那你又把我们黑嚎氏族当成了什么？

say:8:1110305008:1.source_cn: 仇人？你们还不配。你们只是陌生人而已。

say:9:1110305009:1.text: Ungrateful brat! We're taking you back by force if necessary!
say:9:1110305009:1.source_cn: 不识好歹的东西！咱们今天抢也要把你小子抢回去！

say:11:1110305010:1.text: You stop right there, or you'll regret it!
say:11:1110305010:1.source_cn: 冷静一点，索恩！我和你一样气愤，但我们得先想办法……

say:12:1110305011:1.text: Alsa... You're not usually one to use your fists instead of your mouth.
say:12:1110305011:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨……你永远不可能和我一样气愤。

say:13:1110305012:1.text: I'm usually not, but I refuse to let anyone take you away!
say:13:1110305012:1.source_cn: 好了好了，我知道！我绝对不会让他们把你抢走的！

say:14:1110305013:1.text: Does this puny weakling think she can protect you? She's the one who'll need protection!
say:14:1110305013:1.source_cn: 一群乌合之众，还想保护索恩？他们反过来还要你保护，对吗？

say:0:1110308001:0.text: It's Brutus the Blood Claw! Orson lost to him ten years ago.
say:0:1110308001:0.source_cn: 是、是战神布鲁特斯！十年前，击败奥格老大的……

say:1:1110308002:0.text: Luck is not on our side today... Withdraw!
say:1:1110308002:0.source_cn: 今天是不可能占到便宜了……先撤，回去再说。

say:2:1110309002:1.text: How much longer are you going to stand there catching your breath? Don't keep Brutus waiting.
say:2:1110309002:1.source_cn: 你还要深呼吸到什么时候？难道要让布鲁特斯大人等着你吗？

say:3:1110309003:1.source_cn: 我才不会！布鲁特斯大人，您最后一击……相当精彩。

say:4:1110309004:1.text: You have superb battle skills for your age, young man...
say:4:1110309004:1.source_cn: 年轻人，你的武艺在这个年纪也相当不俗。乌尔氏族的——

say:5:1110309005:1.text: You can call him Soren! And my name is Alsa!
say:5:1110309005:1.source_cn: 索恩！布鲁特斯大人，他叫索恩！我……我叫阿尔萨！

say:6:1110309006:1.text: Alsa and Soren... I've heard a lot about you.
say:6:1110309006:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨和索恩？很好，终于把你们的名字跟脸对上了。

say:8:1110309008:1.text: Mikola told me everything. You passed the first trial in just one attempt. That hasn't happened in years.
say:8:1110309008:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉可是隆重地跟我介绍了你们——多年未曾有过，初次参...

say:9:1110309009:1.text: Holy Dusk Lord! Brutus knows our names! Ow! Why did you pinch me? We're not dreaming!
say:9:1110309009:1.source_cn: 啊啊啊啊！布鲁特斯大人知道我们的名字——嗷！你掐我干嘛...

say:10:1110309010:1.text: ... Sorry, it's just so hard to believe...
say:10:1110309010:1.source_cn: ……抱歉，只是……这一切，太不像真的了。

choice_prompt:11:1110309010.text: ... Sorry, it's just so hard to believe...
choice_prompt:11:1110309010.source_cn: ……抱歉，只是……这一切，太不像真的了。

say:12:1110309011:2.text: Soren, Alsa, you were outnumbered, but you still managed to hold your ground while protecting your clan.
say:12:1110309011:2.source_cn: 索恩，阿尔萨，刚才那场战斗，你们以寡敌众，还要保护弱小——

say:13:1110309012:1.text: It was not a fair fight, but you didn't back down.
say:13:1110309012:1.source_cn: 这并不是一场公平的战斗，但你们面对强敌时，从未退缩。

say:14:1110309013:1.text: I hope your fighting spirits will also hold true in the Trial of Souls.
say:14:1110309013:1.source_cn: 那么，在“魂之试炼”中，你们能保持这份坚强吗？

say:15:1110309014:1.text: Of course, we will not run away, no matter how formidable or terrifying our enemies are.
say:15:1110309014:1.source_cn: 嗯。无论敌人何等可怕，我们都绝不会临阵脱逃。

say:17:1110309016:1.source_cn: 在你们眼中，我有那么可怕吗？

say:18:1110309017:1.text: Wait... Are you saying that you're our opponent?
say:18:1110309017:1.source_cn: 什么？……布鲁特斯大人，您的意思是——

say:19:1110309018:1.text: That's right. For the <style="highlight">Trial of Souls</style>, you will have to fight me.

say:20:1110309019:1.text: I'll wait for you at <style="highlight">Heroes' Rest</style> on the day of the trial.

say:21:1110309020:1.text: Out of respect for my old rivals, I'm not going to make it easy. Face me with your true strength.
say:21:1110309020:1.source_cn: 出于对旧日对手的尊重，我不会放水。拿出你们真正的实力对...

say:22:1110309021:1.text: See you all in three days.

say:1:1110310001:2.text: I can't believe we're going to face Brutus in three days... Alsa? Where'd she go?
say:1:1110310001:2.source_cn: 如果要对付布鲁特斯大人——阿尔萨？喂，阿尔萨！

choice_prompt:2:1110310001.text: I can't believe we're going to face Brutus in three days... Alsa? Where'd she go?
choice_prompt:2:1110310001.source_cn: 如果要对付布鲁特斯大人——阿尔萨？喂，阿尔萨！

say:3:1110310002:1.text: We have to face this! Get out here!
say:3:1110310002:1.source_cn: 你这家伙又不肯面对现实了吗？给我出来！

say:4:1110310003:1.text: Let go of me! Soren, are you out of your mind? Do you really think we have a chance against Brutus the Blood Claw?
say:4:1110310003:1.source_cn: 别拽我别拽我！索恩，你是疯了吗？你是真的想挑战战神布鲁...

say:5:1110310004:1.text: Did you see how big his sword was? He might be kind enough to spare our lives, but what if we're grievously injured? Who's going to keep our clan safe if something happens to us?
say:5:1110310004:1.source_cn: 你看到他那把大剑砍下来的力道了吧！即使他宽大为怀，留我...

say:6:1110310005:1.text: The fight hasn't even started yet, and you're already thinking about losing.
say:6:1110310005:1.source_cn: 你这是什么意思……还没开打，就想着输？

say:7:1110310006:1.text: Come on! You can't seriously think you can win against someone like the Blood Claw!
say:7:1110310006:1.source_cn: 我还想问你是什么意思！你莫非觉得你有机会赢？

say:8:1110310007:1.text: So you want to run away and give up this chance to face off against Brutus? Alsa, have you forgotten your promise to Pops?
say:8:1110310007:1.source_cn: 所以，你想临阵脱逃？你想放弃和战神做对手的机会？阿尔萨...

say:9:1110310008:1.text: He left the clan in our care. We must prove to the entire desert that the Uru Clan is the strongest.
say:9:1110310008:1.source_cn: 老爹将氏族托付给我们，所以，我们要向整片沙漠证明乌尔氏族——

say:10:1110310009:1.text: Would you wake up?! The Uru Clan needs to survive first.
say:10:1110310009:1.source_cn: 你给我清醒点好吗？我们要做的是让乌尔氏族活下来！

say:11:1110310010:1.text: And in order to survive, we need to conserve our strength. I'm not fighting a losing battle!
say:11:1110310010:1.source_cn: 为了活下来，必须保存力量！这种必败的挑战，我绝不会去！

say:13:1110310012:1.text: You're right. I am a coward, but that's still better than a selfish idiot who only cares about being strong!
say:13:1110310012:1.source_cn: 对，我是懦弱，但也好过你自私！你只想要挑战，从不想后果！

say:14:1110310013:2.text: Anything can happen on the battlefield. We haven't lost yet.
say:14:1110310013:2.source_cn: 战斗中，什么都可能发生，没有哪场战斗必定会输。

say:15:1110310014:1.text: The strong never run away. Alsa, when the day of the trial comes...
say:15:1110310014:1.source_cn: 强者不会逃避。到了约定之日，阿尔萨……

say:16:1110310015:1.text: ...I'll be there, with or without you.
say:16:1110310015:1.source_cn: 随便你去不去。我一个人也会准时赴约的。

choice:2:0:1.text: She curled up in a ball.
choice:2:0:1.male: She curled up in a ball.
choice:2:0:1.female: She curled up in a ball.

say:1:1110311002:0.text: Well, I'm not strong. I just want to live. So does everyone else!
say:1:1110311002:0.source_cn: 我不是什么强者，我只想活下来！大家也是这样！

say:2:1110311003:0.text: If someone gets abandoned because they're not strong, how are we different from the other clans?
say:2:1110311003:0.source_cn: 如果因为不是强者，就理所应当被抛弃——那和黑嚎又有什么区别？

say:2:1110313002:1.text: Today, we must face Brutus. We'll miss the trial if we don't leave now.
say:2:1110313002:1.source_cn: 今天就是和布鲁特斯大人约定好的日期。再不出发，就会错过...
say:2:1110313002:1.male: Today, we must face Brutus. We'll miss the trial if we don't leave now.
say:2:1110313002:1.female: Today, we must face Brutus. We'll miss the trial if we don't leave now.

choice_prompt:3:1110313002.text: Today, we must face Brutus. We'll miss the trial if we don't leave now.
choice_prompt:3:1110313002.source_cn: 今天就是和布鲁特斯大人约定好的日期。再不出发，就会错过试炼了。
choice_prompt:3:1110313002.male: Today, we must face Brutus. We'll miss the trial if we don't leave now.
choice_prompt:3:1110313002.female: Today, we must face Brutus. We'll miss the trial if we don't leave now.

say:5:1110313003:1.text: Yeah, Soren. You're not going to check on Alsa? You've been waiting here for her, haven't you?
say:5:1110313003:1.source_cn: 对啊，索恩。你不去问问阿尔萨的情况吗？我看到你站在这里...

say:6:1110313005:1.text: You're mistaken. I just needed a quiet moment to myself before the battle.
say:6:1110313005:1.source_cn: 别误会。大战在即，我只想一个人冷静冷静。

say:10:1110313004:1.text: Yeah, Soren. You've been standing here the entire morning. We can wait a bit longer for her.
say:10:1110313004:1.source_cn: 是啊，索恩！你在这里站了一早上，是在等阿尔萨吧？还是再...

say:1:1110314002:0.text: They're Mauler spirits summoned by the will of battle.
say:1:1110314002:0.source_cn: 是英灵，被战意召唤出的蛮血的英灵们……

say:1:1110319001:1.text: That's enough for today. You won this fight.
say:1:1110319001:1.source_cn: 今天就到这里吧。这场战斗，是你们赢了。

say:2:1110319002:1.text: We won...? Alsa and I... beat Brutus the Blood Claw?
say:2:1110319002:1.source_cn: 我们……真的赢了？……我和阿尔萨，赢了战神布鲁特斯？

say:3:1110319003:1.text: I can't believe it! I thought we were done for!
say:3:1110319003:1.source_cn: 真的吗？刚才那下子，还以为我们要完蛋了！

say:4:1110319004:1.text: It's your victory, and it was fun.
say:4:1110319004:1.source_cn: 是你们的胜利。啊，真是场有趣的战斗——

choice_prompt:5:1110319004.text: It's your victory, and it was fun.
choice_prompt:5:1110319004.source_cn: 是你们的胜利。啊，真是场有趣的战斗——

say:6:1110319005:1.text: I remember you, Magister. You're a friend of the Uru Clan.
say:6:1110319005:1.source_cn: 我记得这位魔法师打扮的朋友，你是乌尔氏族的帮手。
say:6:1110319005:1.male: I remember you, Magister. You're a friend of the Uru Clan.
say:6:1110319005:1.female: I remember you, Magister. You're a friend of the Uru Clan.

say:7:1110319006:1.text: You have no issue with this result, right?
say:7:1110319006:1.source_cn: 你对这个结果，没有异议吧？
say:7:1110319006:1.male: You have no issue with this result, right?
say:7:1110319006:1.female: You have no issue with this result, right?

say:8:1110319009:1.text: What are you and <style="stress"><player_name></style> whispering about?
say:8:1110319009:1.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人居然也会嘀嘀咕咕地说话……<style=s...
say:8:1110319009:1.male: What are you and <style="stress"><player_name></style> whispering about?
say:8:1110319009:1.female: What are you and <style="stress"><player_name></style> whispering about?

say:9:1110319010:1.text: Nothing. Your friend was showing concern. That's all.
say:9:1110319010:1.source_cn: 没什么。你们的朋友表示了关心，仅此而已。

say:10:1110319011:1.text: You may have won, but the trial isn't over yet.
say:10:1110319011:1.source_cn: 这场战斗中你们占了上风，不过试炼还没结束——

say:11:1110319012:1.text: Alsa, Soren, I have a question for you.
say:11:1110319012:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨，索恩，我有个问题问你们。

say:13:1110319014:1.text: Why did you sign up for the Warsong Festival?
say:13:1110319014:1.source_cn: 你们——为什么要参加战歌节？

say:14:1110319015:1.text: Well, to be honest, I've been thinking about this since... since my fight with Soren the other day.
say:14:1110319015:1.source_cn: 参加战歌节的原因吗？实话说，和索恩吵架之后，这几天……...

say:15:1110319016:1.text: I'm here to fulfill our promise to our pops. The Uru Clan can only be recognized if we gain glory and honor at the Warsong Festival.
say:15:1110319016:1.source_cn: 我参加战歌节，是为了实现和老爹的约定。只有在战歌节上获...

say:16:1110319017:1.text: I know how brutal this desert can be. Survival is not guaranteed.
say:16:1110319017:1.source_cn: 我比谁都清楚，这片沙漠是多可怕的地方。这是无法只靠少数...

say:17:1110319018:1.text: I want the Uru Clan to be respected among the other clans. If we lose our chance in this Warsong Festival, we'll have to wait another ten years...
say:17:1110319018:1.source_cn: 我想让乌尔氏族被看到、被尊重。如果错过这个战歌节，就要...

say:18:1110319019:1.text: I understand. Soren, what about you?

say:20:1110319021:1.text: I aim to get stronger, to shield those I hold dear.
say:20:1110319021:1.source_cn: 我想变得更强，保护想保护的人。

say:21:1110319022:1.text: Become stronger, huh? I hope you won't forget what you said today...
say:21:1110319022:1.source_cn: 变强……是吗。原来如此。希望之后的试炼和比赛中，你们不...

say:22:1110319023:1.text: You've cleared this trial. I'll inform Mikola of your triumph. Go to her and inquire about your next challenge. I'll take my leave now.
say:22:1110319023:1.source_cn: 你们通过了这项试炼，我会把结果告知曼卡拉。你们也别忘记...

say:23:1110319024:1.text: Soren, Alsa, I expect to see you at Mars Peak.
say:23:1110319024:1.source_cn: 索恩，阿尔萨，希望能在战神峰上看到你们。

say:24:1110319025:1.text: Yes... I promise we'll meet you there!
say:24:1110319025:1.source_cn: 我也……期待能在战神峰见到您。

say:26:1110319007:1.text: Shhh... Don't be so loud, Magister.
say:26:1110319007:1.source_cn: 小点声，这位魔法师打扮的朋友。
say:26:1110319007:1.male: Shhh... Don't be so loud, Magister.
say:26:1110319007:1.female: Shhh... Don't be so loud, Magister.

say:27:1110319008:1.text: I believe in fair fights, but we need to nurture our young warriors and not put them down like other clans do.
say:27:1110319008:1.source_cn: 我崇尚公平的战斗，但给予年轻人的公平，总是有所不同。
say:27:1110319008:1.male: I believe in fair fights, but we need to nurture our young warriors and not put them down like other clans do.
say:27:1110319008:1.female: I believe in fair fights, but we need to nurture our young warriors and not put them down like other clans do.

say:1:1110316001:1.text: Do you accept defeat? Do you accept that the Uru Clan lost?
say:1:1110316001:1.source_cn: 不甘心吗？你会接受吗，乌尔氏族在战歌节的失败？

say:2:1110316002:0.text: I won't give up! But... I have to concede. It was a fair fight, and I couldn't best you.
say:2:1110316002:0.source_cn: 我——我不甘心！但必须承认，这是公平的战斗，我无法战胜您……

say:3:1110316003:0.text: Understood. I will now proclaim the results of the Trial of Souls.
say:3:1110316003:0.source_cn: 我明白了，那么，乌尔氏族的魂之试炼……

say:11:1110316004:1.text: Sir! The Uru Clan sent two warriors to the trials. I apologize for my tardiness...
say:11:1110316004:1.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人，如您所见，乌尔氏族的代表是两个人！

say:12:1110316005:1.text: Could you give us one more chance?
say:12:1110316005:1.source_cn: 您看，我们……可以再得到一次试炼的机会吗？

say:13:1110316006:1.text: The Warsong Festival rules don't address this, so I suppose it's my call...
say:13:1110316006:1.source_cn: 战歌节的规则并没有涵盖你们这种情况。也就是说，裁量权在我——

say:14:1110316007:1.text: I've made my decision... Let's see what you two can do together!
say:14:1110316007:1.source_cn: 不过，我同意。让我看看你们两个人拼尽全力的样子吧！

narration:16:11010103:0.text: Alsa appears when Brutus is about to announce the result of the trial.
narration:16:11010103:0.source_cn: 就在布鲁特斯即将宣布试炼失败时，阿尔萨出现了。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1110315002:.source_cn: 今天，我的对手只有你吗？

cinematic_dialogue:1:1110315004:.text: I'm here alone on behalf of the Uru Clan!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1110315004:.source_cn: 索恩，独自代表乌尔氏族迎战！
